description: This Java source file defines the ChangeQueueActor class, an Akka actor responsible for collecting changes related to 'Thing' updates and forwarding snapshots downstream. It manages a cache of change metadata for each Thing and provides mechanisms to produce streams of current change states.

classes.name: ChangeQueueActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that caches Thing metadata changes and emits snapshots of current cache content.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for actor instantiation.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling behavior for the actor.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new Metadata change to the cache.

methods.name: createSource
methods.description: Creates an Akka Stream source that periodically emits snapshots of the current cache state.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Handles dump command to emit the current cache and reset it.

methods.name: askSelf
methods.description: Creates a source that asks the actor itself for current cache state.
